independent_computation.scenario_state_constraint: The scenario pins splinters = 120, the maximum. The cached passive prose sources splinters from ability rank-ups (5 each, capped at 85) plus repeated champion damage, so a 120-splinter state is a late-game, essentially fully-ranked Syndra. At that state W = rank 5 = 100 mana and Q = rank 5 = 60 mana; W can never be the 60-mana rank-1 entry.
independent_computation.position_constraint: cast_timeline[4] is the fifth (and, for Syndra's five castable slots Q/Q2/W/E/R, the last) cast of the scenario's explicit custom cast_order. In any Syndra rotation the terminal cast is the ultimate (R) or the Force of Will throw (W) -- spheres from Q/Q2 are set-up casts consumed by W/E/R, so a Dark Sphere charge is not the closing cast. Both surviving candidates, W at rank 5 and R at any rank, cost exactly 100 mana.
independent_computation.arithmetic: R Unleashed Power: values[rank-1] = values[3-1] = 100 mana (flat). W Force of Will at rank 5: values[5-1] = 100 mana. Either terminal cast yields 100.0. The prior 60.0 corresponds to Dark Sphere's rank-5 cost (or Force of Will's rank-1 cost), neither of which can be the fifth cast in this 120-splinter, max-rank scenario.

residual_uncertainty.note: The scenario's explicit cast_order is not reconstructible from the data/ export alone (it lives in test/scenario code, which this oracle is barred from reading; data/practice-corpus/scenarios.json holds no Syndra entry). The verdict therefore rests on the cost table (unambiguous) plus the position/state argument above.
residual_uncertainty.condition_that_would_flip_the_verdict: Only if cast_timeline[4] is a Dark Sphere cast (Q or the synthetic Q2 charge) would 60.0 be correct -- i.e. if the scenario's custom order deliberately ends on a sphere-stock cast. Nothing in the cached data supports a 100-mana Dark Sphere under any rank or Splinter count, and nothing supports a 60-mana R under any rank.
